text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here she comes! Marvelous Sunday makes her move!
She's surging, stretching outâwhat a magnificent run!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Not yet, not yet,
not yet, not yet, not yet, not YET!!
My Marvelous will never stop!☆)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Because it'll reach them! It definitely will! If I
can just be the absolute most marvelous here!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: A wonderful run from Marvelous Sunday! Cheers are erupting from the entire crowd!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha! Thank you, everyone!
How was it!?
Was my running marvelousーーー!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, she's laughing so hard! Marvelous Sunday's pretty great, honestly.
So super cheerful!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still... hey, look at this. I thought I hadn't heard
much about her until last year, so I looked her up,
and... see?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's really suffered from injuries and bad conditions.
...Yet she kept fighting through it all.
And that's why she's still able to keep smiling even now.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
So that's what happened...
...I don't know, things like that, you know?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's great, you know. Like it turns into a positive...
It really encourages me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday dashed brilliantly through the Osaka Hai,
putting on a marvelous display of her own
that was second to none of her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the next stage she and I are heading to at last—
is the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it, Trainer.
—Let's give it everything we've got!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You, me, and everyone else!
All of us together!
